paragraphs: Both jobs last ran on 2026-10-20 and are green with unchanged results: Scala 2.13 (retronym/scala#139) 198 passed, 20 pending, 3 skipped; Scala 3 (retronym/scala3#26) 169 passed, 18 pending, 34 skipped. Both still pin Zinc b6c94565 (develop as of 2026-10-12), so neither has exercised anything merged since, including zinc#1851 and scala/scala#11360. Moving `ZINC_PINNED_SHA` is the next step before the numbers mean anything for this month.

The port of zinc#1807 to scala2-sbt-bridge has landed as scala/scala#11360 (2026-11-03). That is the gap behind the 2.13 skip `module-inheritance-extra-hash`, so the skip should be removable once the pin moves past that commit. I haven't run it. The one confirmed 2.13 gap left is zinc#1310 (`@inline`); its scenario `inline` is still disabled in Zinc, so no run exercises it.

Zinc's pending markers on develop (728b7fdc) fell from 20 to 15: `reporter/errors-reported`, `abstract-class-to-trait`, `false-error`, `nested-type-params` and `no-type-annotation` are no longer pending. The last two are exactly the scenarios the Scala 3 skip table lists as "pending in Zinc, passes on Scala 3", so those two entries can go when the pin moves. The Scala 3 table is otherwise as before: five bridge gaps (#1324, #1807, `empty-package`, `malformed-class-name-with-dollar`, `main-discovery`), 13 Scala 2 only scenarios and 14 not triaged.

Since the last report, Scala 3 merged scala3#27271 (deferred terms marked abstract in the API sent to Zinc), #27272 (inline parameters excluded again when hashing inline bodies), #27366 (unstable API markers for secondary type parameters) and #27445. zinc#1851 landed on develop and has a scala2 port open as retronym/scala#141, but no 1.13.x backport yet. sbt/zinc's `1.12.x` branch is gone; 1.13.0 was released on 2026-10-27 and `1.13.x` is the stable line the report now follows.
